title: The descent inventory: 31 canonical structures through the McKay chain
claim_one_line: THE DESCENT INVENTORY (the field-masterplan W2, loop-until-dry, two adversarial lenses per verdict, 12 disputes bench-adjudicated, zero reversals): 31 canonical structures of Q(sqrt-3) tested through the McKay chain 2T -> affine E6 -> e6 -- 17 OBSTRUCTED, 10 DESCENDS, 4 ALREADY-BANKED, with the critic's 15 unconverged proposals typed as the honest pending tail (bounded-by-rounds, not dry).
